name: Raypass
description: A password manager: logins, notes, cards, identities and crypto wallets, end-to-end encrypted between your devices.

actions.name: raypass.status
actions.description: Whether a vault exists and is locked, item and trash counts, orphaned entries and the keyring ids of orphaned vaults (orphaned_keyrings, see raypass.recover), settings, the KDF round count and locks_in. No secrets.

actions.name: raypass.setup
actions.description: Create the vault with a master password (at least 8 characters). Refused if one exists. Leaves the vault unlocked.

actions.name: raypass.unlock
actions.description: Unlock the vault with the master password. Wrong password: unauthorized; after 5 failures in a row each try waits longer.

actions.name: raypass.lock
actions.description: Lock the vault now: the key and every decrypted value are dropped.

actions.name: raypass.change_password
actions.description: Change the master password (old, new, optional PBKDF2 iter). Other devices unlock with the new one.

actions.name: raypass.list
actions.description: Items without secrets. Filters: query (words in name, user, URLs, folder, tags), type, folder (and its subfolders), fav, trash (true lists the trash), url (logins matching it). Favourites first, then by name.

actions.name: raypass.get
actions.description: One item with every field, secrets included.

actions.name: raypass.add
actions.description: Add an item: type (login, note, card, identity, wallet), name, and fields of the type. Common: folder, fav, tags, notes, fields [{name,value,hidden}]. login: user, pass, urls, totp. card: holder, number, exp, cvv, brand. identity: first, last, email, phone, address, company. wallet: seed, privkey, address, network, passphrase, derivation.

actions.name: raypass.update
actions.description: Set fields of an item (null clears one; the type cannot change; secret fields are declared so Sol never stores them while an approval waits). Changing a login's pass keeps the old one in its history.

actions.name: raypass.trash
actions.description: Move items to the trash.

actions.name: raypass.restore
actions.description: Take items out of the trash.

actions.name: raypass.purge
actions.description: Delete items in the trash for good (ids, or all_trash: true).

actions.name: raypass.generate
actions.description: Generate a password (mode chars: length 4-128, upper, lower, digits, symbols, avoid_ambiguous) or a passphrase (mode words: words 3-20, separator, capitalize, number), with its entropy in bits.

actions.name: raypass.totp
actions.description: The current TOTP code of an item, with its period and the seconds it stays valid.

actions.name: raypass.match
actions.description: Logins whose URLs match a page or app URL (androidapp://<package>), best match first. No secrets. A row has insecure: true when the page is plain http and the login was saved for https.

actions.name: raypass.fill
actions.description: User, password and current TOTP code of a login, only if one of its URLs matches url. A login saved for https is refused on a plain http page (forbidden, insecure page) unless allow_insecure is true, which a client sends only after the person confirmed.

actions.name: raypass.save_login
actions.description: Save a login seen on a page: updates the password of the matching login with the same user (history kept), else adds one named after the host.

actions.name: raypass.folders
actions.description: Folders in use with the number of items in each.

actions.name: raypass.health
actions.description: Weak, reused (groups) and old (over a year) passwords of logins, by id, and a score out of 100. No secrets.

actions.name: raypass.export
actions.description: Export the vault (not the trash) as Raypass JSON, CSV (Bitwarden layout) or an encrypted Raypass file protected by password.

actions.name: raypass.import
actions.description: Import another manager's export. data is the file's text, or with encoding base64 the file's bytes in base64 (binary files such as Proton Pass's zip). format: auto, bitwarden_json, bitwarden_csv, chrome_csv, firefox_csv, 1password_csv, keepass_csv, lastpass_csv, protonpass_json (data.json or the export zip), protonpass_csv, raypass_json, raypass_encrypted (needs password). Exact duplicates are skipped. Returns imported, skipped, the detected format and notes (what the file held that could not be imported, such as passkeys).

actions.name: raypass.recover
actions.description: Recover the items of an orphaned vault (set up on another device while offline; raypass.status lists its keyring id in orphaned_keyrings) into this one: password is that vault's master password, keyring optionally picks one. Its live items are added here with new ids; exact duplicates are skipped. Needs this vault unlocked.

actions.name: raypass.settings
actions.description: Change synced settings: auto_lock (minutes without use, 0 = never), clip_clear (seconds before a copied secret is cleared). Returns the settings.
